+@pytest.mark.parametrize('command,install_roles,install_collections,warning', [
+    (['install'], True, True, False),
+    (['install', '-p', '/tmp/galaxy-roles'], True, False, True),
+    (['role', 'install'], True, False, False),
+    (['collection', 'install'], False, True, False),
+])
+def test_mixed_requirements_install(tmp_path, monkeypatch, command, install_roles, install_collections, warning):
+    req_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(req_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles:\n- name: example.role\ncollections:\n- example.collection\n')
+
+    role_install = MagicMock(return_value=0)
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    warnings = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, 'execute_install_role', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.cli.galaxy, 'install_collections', collection_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.utils.display.Display, 'warning', warnings)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.cli.galaxy, 'validate_collection_path', lambda path: str(tmp_path))
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy'] + command + ['-r', req_file]).run()
+
+    assert bool(role_install.call_count) is install_roles
+    assert bool(collection_install.call_count) is install_collections
+    if warning:
+        assert any('Collections cannot be installed to a roles path' in call[0][0]
+                   for call in warnings.call_args_list)
+    if install_collections:
+        assert collection_install.call_args[0][0] == [('example.collection', '*', None)]
+
+
+def test_empty_requirements_skip_install(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):
+    req_file = str(tmp_path / 'requirements.yml')
+    with open(req_file, 'w') as req_obj:
+        req_obj.write('roles: []\ncollections: []\n')
+    role_install = MagicMock()
+    collection_install = MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, 'execute_install_role', role_install)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ansible.cli.galaxy, 'install_collections', collection_install)
+
+    GalaxyCLI(['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', req_file]).run()
+
+    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' in capsys.readouterr().out
+    role_install.assert_not_called()
+    collection_install.assert_not_called()
+
+
